answers.question: Which area of engineering are you most interested in?
Can you work on site or relocate?
answers.answer: Yes. Willing to relocate and to work on site, hybrid or remote.

answers.question: How did you hear about this job?
answers.answer: From a public list of internship and new-grad postings on GitHub. On a list of options pick the generic one that fits (job board, online, GitHub, other). Never pick a named site, event or person that was not the source.

answers.question: May the company keep my data for future roles after this application?
answers.answer: No. Decline when it is optional or when the form offers a choice.

answers.question: Yes or no questions about my history that the facts do not mention: criminal convictions, non-compete agreements, having worked at this company before, relatives who work there
